shell.tagline: Lafiya da kariya ga kowace uwa.

login.title: Barka da dawowa
login.subtitle: Shiga domin ci gaba.
login.wrong: Lambar waya, imel ko kalmar sirri ba daidai ba ne.
login.help: Asibitinku zai yi muku rajista, ya aiko muku da imel don ku saita kalmar sirri.

invite.expiredBody: Hanyar haɗin gayyata tana aiki sau ɗaya kuma tana ɗaukar kwanaki 7. Ku roƙi ƙungiyar Aboyun ta aiko muku wata sabuwa, ko ku shiga idan kun riga kun saita kalmar sirrinku.
invite.submit: Saita kalmar sirri, sannan ku ci gaba
invite.invalid: Wannan hanyar haɗin ba ta aiki ko ta ƙare. Ku roƙi ƙungiyar Aboyun wata sabuwa.
invite.failed: Ba mu iya saita kalmar sirrinku ba. Da fatan a sake gwadawa.

Errors.identifierRequired: Shigar da lambar waya ko imel
Errors.identifierInvalid: Shigar da ingantacciyar lambar wayar Najeriya ko imel
Errors.passwordMin: Yi amfani da haruffa 8 ko fiye
Errors.passwordMax: Kalmar sirri ta yi tsayi da yawa
Errors.passwordMismatch: Kalmomin sirri ba su yi daidai ba

Email.inviteIntro: An yi muku rajista a Aboyun. Yi amfani da hanyar haɗin da ke ƙasa don saita kalmar sirrinku ku shiga.
Email.resetSubject: Sake saita kalmar sirrinku ta Aboyun
Email.resetIntro: Yi amfani da hanyar haɗin da ke ƙasa don zaɓar sabuwar kalmar sirri.
Email.footer: Wannan hanyar haɗin tana aiki sau ɗaya kuma za ta ƙare bayan kwanaki 7.
Email.sms: Aboyun: saita kalmar sirrinku a nan: {url}

home.needsConnection: Yi amfani da intanet sau ɗaya don mu ɗora bayananki. Bayan haka manhajar za ta yi aiki ba tare da intanet ba.
home.noVisit: Ba a ba ki ranar ziyara ba tukuna. Asibitinki zai gaya miki.
home.passed: Ranar ziyarar nan ta wuce. Don Allah ki je asibitinki.
home.emergencyHint: Danna idan ke ko jaririnki kuna buƙatar taimako yanzu

LOW.title: Kina cikin ƙoshin lafiya
LOW.body: Ci gaba da zuwa ziyararki kuma ki riƙa shan maganinki.

MEDIUM.title: Asibitinki yana kula da ke sosai
MEDIUM.body: Don Allah kada ki rasa ziyararki ta gaba.

HIGH.title: Asibitinki yana son ganinki nan ba da daɗewa ba
HIGH.body: Don Allah ki kira asibitinki, ko ki je ziyararki ta gaba.

check.title: Duba alamun rashin lafiya
check.intro: Ki yi tunani yadda jikinki yake yanzu. Ki amsa eh ko a'a.
check.answerAll: Don Allah ki amsa dukkan tambayoyin.
check.none: Ba ki yi bincike ba tukuna.

signs.fits: Kin yi suma ko kamawa da ba za ki iya hanawa ba?
signs.movement: Jaririn cikinki yana motsi ƙasa da yadda ya saba?
signs.fever: Kina da zazzaɓi ko jikinki yana zafi sosai?

OK.title: Babu alamar haɗari
OK.body: Ba ki da alamar haɗari yanzu. Ci gaba da zuwa ziyararki. Ki sake dubawa idan jikinki ya canza.

CLINIC_SOON.title: Don Allah ki je asibiti nan ba da daɗewa ba
CLINIC_SOON.body: Ɗaya daga cikin amsoshinki yana buƙatar ma'aikaciyar jinya ta duba. Don Allah ki je asibitinki yau ko gobe.

GO_NOW.title: Don Allah ki je asibiti yanzu
GO_NOW.body: Ki je asibitinki ko cibiyar lafiya mafi kusa yanzu. Ki nemi wani ya raka ki. Idan ba za ki iya zuwa ba, ki danna maɓallin gaggawa.

result_label.CLINIC_SOON: Ki je asibiti nan ba da daɗewa ba

emergency.title: Me ya faru?
emergency.intro: Zaɓi wanda ya fi kusa. Za a sanar da asibitinki da danginki.
emergency.sentBody: Ki tsaya inda kike idan babu haɗari. Ana shirya taimako.
emergency.queuedBody: An adana shi a wannan wayar. Za a aika da zarar kin samu intanet. Ki kira ko ki yi wa asibitinki saƙo yanzu.
emergency.smsBody: GAGGAWA. Ni ce {name}. {kind}. Don Allah ku taimake ni.

install.hint: Sanya Aboyun a wayarki don ta buɗe kamar kowace manhaja, ko da babu data.
install.ios: Don sanyawa: danna maɓallin Share, sannan “Add to Home Screen”.

session.expiredBody: Ba ki yi amfani da intanet ba fiye da kwanaki 7. Ki sake shiga don a tsare bayananki.

offline.title: Babu intanet
offline.body: Ba a adana wannan shafin a wayarki ba tukuna. Ki haɗa intanet ki sake gwadawa.
